facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether an implementation language is explicitly declared for the affected subject.

facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether the affected subject creates, changes, migrates, restores, retains, or removes persisted state.

facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether a concrete interchange or storage format is selected for the affected subject.

facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether the affected subject reads, writes, derives, transmits, or discloses sensitive information.

facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether the affected subject introduces or changes a serialized exchange boundary.

facts.evidenceGuidance: Analyze the complete affected target and record a scoped assertion for this fact.
facts.meaning: Whether information or authority crosses a boundary at which claims require validation before reliance.

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The subject shares infrastructure without exclusive assumptions or unbounded interference with neighboring workloads.
evidencePrompts: Measure interference in connections, storage, processor use, ports, queues, or other shared resources.
scenarioPrompts: Run beside a representative neighbor under shared resource limits.
clauses.title: Co-existence

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Every exchange surface has a specified, versioned contract sufficient for an independent implementation, and observed bytes and behavior conform to it.
evidencePrompts: Compare schemas, encodings, units, error vocabulary, and observable behavior at the byte boundary.
scenarioPrompts: Exchange valid, boundary, and invalid messages with an independently implemented peer.
clauses.title: Interoperability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Supported adjacent protocol and schema versions interoperate across the stated upgrade window, with an explicit policy for unknown valid fields and version-breaking changes.
evidencePrompts: Record an explicit outcome or non-applicability reason for each supported matrix cell.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise every supported version pair during upgrade and rollback conditions where promised.
clauses.title: Version tolerance

qualities.summary: The subject coexists with neighbors and exchanges versioned information with independent implementations and adjacent versions.
qualities.title: Compatibility

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Recorded values agree with their comparison authority at the required precision, with units, zones, and rounding policy explicit.
evidencePrompts: Measure admitted error against the explicit tolerance; exact contracts require exact equality.
scenarioPrompts: Compare representative and boundary values with the named authority using the stated units and precision.
clauses.title: Accuracy and precision

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Records are whole, required references resolve, and cross-record invariants hold at every observable boundary including concurrency, retry, and partial failure.
evidencePrompts: Evaluate invariants at every observable transaction boundary and reject any reachable invalid state.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise invariant-preserving transitions under concurrency, retry, interruption, and partial failure.
clauses.title: Completeness and consistency

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Consumers can determine value age, each derived or cached value has a stated staleness bound, and behavior after the bound is explicit.
evidencePrompts: Measure knowable age, eligible population, window, and the required over-bound response.
scenarioPrompts: Read eligible values before, at, and after the consumer-specific staleness bound.
clauses.title: Freshness

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Every assertion identifies its recording source, authority, and sufficient permitted provenance to judge trustworthiness without treating mere presence as proof.
evidencePrompts: Verify structured, resolvable provenance while preserving declared disclosure and retention boundaries.
scenarioPrompts: Reconstruct the origin and authority of every representative assertion class.
clauses.title: Credibility and provenance

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Derived information can be traced to its inputs, logic version, and computation time so affected outputs can be enumerated and recomputation explained.
evidencePrompts: Verify blast-radius enumeration and explain whether and why recomputation differs.
scenarioPrompts: Select representative derived values, enumerate inputs, and repeat computation with the recorded logic version.
clauses.title: Lineage

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Information survives named faults and migrations for exactly its stated retention, and end-of-retention removal includes derived copies, indexes, and caches.
evidencePrompts: Compare meaning after recovery and verify recovery bounds plus complete derivative removal by its deadline.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise backup, restore, migration, named faults, and end-of-retention removal.
clauses.title: Durability and retention

qualities.summary: Recorded information is accurate, complete, consistent, fresh enough, attributable, traceable, and durable for exactly its stated retention.
qualities.title: Data quality

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Behavior that legitimately varies by environment varies through explicit configuration with stated defaults rather than environment-specific branches in core behavior.
evidencePrompts: Verify successful behavior and declared defaults in every supported matrix cell.
scenarioPrompts: Vary the supported environment matrix through configuration while holding required behavior constant.
clauses.title: Adaptability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The scaling model states how instances, state, writers, tenants, data, and traffic grow, and following that model increases capacity without redesign.
evidencePrompts: Measure throughput, latency, and resource use across multiple points on the scaling curve.
scenarioPrompts: Apply a growth stimulus, the stated scaling action, and the relevant state-placement constraints.
clauses.title: Scalability and elasticity

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Every supported deployment shape installs and initializes through repeatable supplied steps from a clean environment.
evidencePrompts: Record success, repeatability, initialization bounds, and any undeclared manual step.
scenarioPrompts: Install each supported shape from a clean environment using only supplied artifacts and descriptions.
clauses.title: Deployability and installability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Components declared substitutable preserve a complete shared contract, pass common conformance obligations, and are not bypassed by consumers reaching concrete implementations.
evidencePrompts: Verify equivalent observable behavior and absence of concrete-type reach-around across the seam.
scenarioPrompts: Run the same contract and conformance corpus against every claimed implementation.
clauses.title: Replaceability

qualities.summary: The subject adapts to environments, load, deployment shapes, and substitutable components without source modification.
qualities.title: Flexibility

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Every behavior promised by the governing need or contract is delivered, including every admitted branch, parameter, case, and documented surface.
evidencePrompts: Compare each promise with named evidence that demonstrates the corresponding behavior.
scenarioPrompts: Enumerate promised behaviors and critical journeys, then exercise every named obligation.
clauses.title: Completeness

clauses.affirmativeObligation: For every admitted input, including boundary, empty, maximal, reordered, concurrent, and error inputs where relevant, behavior produces the specified observable result.
evidencePrompts: Use examples, properties, or a conformance corpus that covers the admitted input space.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise input classes, boundaries, failures, and permitted orderings against exact postconditions.
clauses.title: Correctness

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The delivered functions fit the actual need without missing steps that force workarounds or speculative surface without a named need.
evidencePrompts: Trace each delivered surface to a current need and show that the supported journey is complete.
scenarioPrompts: Name the actor, goal, supported surface, and any workaround required to complete the goal.
clauses.title: Appropriateness

qualities.summary: The subject does the right things, does them correctly, and does all of them without introducing unneeded behavior.
qualities.title: Functionality

clauses.affirmativeObligation: A change to one concern remains within a bounded cohesive set of owners, and unrelated concerns do not interact through hidden mutable state or ambiguous ownership.
evidencePrompts: Verify semantic locality without unrelated coordinated edits.
scenarioPrompts: Apply a representative change stimulus and identify the artifacts expected to absorb it.
clauses.title: Modularity and orthogonality

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Existing behavior is composed from one owner instead of reimplemented, and equivalent implementations preserve one shared observable contract.
evidencePrompts: Identify duplicate owners and compare their behavior for divergence.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise the shared contract against every implementation or consumer.
clauses.title: Reuse and composability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: A maintainer can determine what occurred and why from structured telemetry, preserved error causes, and inspectable decision state.
evidencePrompts: Verify that the affected operation, selected branch, and cause are identifiable within a bounded exercise.
scenarioPrompts: Introduce a named failure or decision outcome and diagnose its branch and cause from available telemetry.
clauses.title: Observability and diagnosability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Likely changes have a local extension point, and complexity remains proportionate, without central case rewrites, speculative indirection, or avoidable cleverness.
evidencePrompts: Inspect whether the extension is additive and whether every abstraction has a current purpose.
scenarioPrompts: Apply a plausible extension and identify the minimal owners that must change.
clauses.title: Modifiability and simplicity

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Behavior is provable at the tier where it lives because dependencies have controllable seams, failures can be induced, and nondeterminism can be supplied explicitly.
evidencePrompts: Verify the observable contract without requiring unrelated infrastructure or ambient state.
scenarioPrompts: Name the behavior and induce its success, failure, boundary, and nondeterministic cases at the owning tier.
clauses.title: Testability and provability

qualities.summary: The subject can be understood, diagnosed, changed, reused, and proven without effort disproportionate to the change.
qualities.title: Maintainability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Lifecycle transitions are deliberate and lossless: accepted work is completed or handed off, load controls are invokable, and runtime-tunable settings take effect as declared.
evidencePrompts: Measure completion bounds, accepted-work loss, and state visible at the operating boundary.
scenarioPrompts: Initiate drain, shutdown, shedding, backpressure, and runtime adjustment under representative in-flight load.
clauses.title: Operational control

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Recurring administrative acts are supported, attributable operations with defined retry and recovery behavior rather than direct data surgery.
evidencePrompts: Verify intended state, attribution, retry behavior, and absence of unsupported direct mutation.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise recurring onboarding, offboarding, limit, credential, and key-lifecycle journeys where applicable.
clauses.title: Administration

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Version upgrades and data migrations have a rehearsed forward path compatible with the supported topology and an explicit rollback or roll-forward posture.
evidencePrompts: Record disruption, data meaning, protocol compatibility, and the tested recovery postcondition.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise every supported source-to-target version path in the relevant topology.
clauses.title: Upgrade and migration

clauses.affirmativeObligation: A deployment exposes consumer-relevant health and saturation, and every condition requiring human action names that action and its urgency.
evidencePrompts: Verify timely signals, accurate readiness, bounded cardinality, required action, and urgency.
scenarioPrompts: Introduce consumer-visible failures and saturation before the failure boundary is crossed.
clauses.title: Monitoring and alerting

clauses.affirmativeObligation: A responder can collect safe diagnostics, follow an available recovery path, and escalate anticipated failures without access to implementation internals or unauthorized material.
evidencePrompts: Measure time to safe diagnostics, correct recovery branch, and the stated recovery or escalation point.
scenarioPrompts: Rehearse an anticipated failure with a responder unfamiliar with the implementation.
clauses.title: Supportability

qualities.summary: A deployed subject can be controlled, administered, upgraded, observed, and supported by operators who did not construct it.
qualities.title: Manageability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Quality-significant operations have stated latency budgets at meaningful percentiles and meet those budgets under the stated load and payload conditions.
evidencePrompts: Report the latency distribution and the proportion of eligible operations meeting the threshold.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise an eligible operation under its stated load, payload class, percentile, and measurement point.
clauses.title: Responsiveness

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The subject sustains stated request, event, and batch rates, and deadline-bearing work completes within its stated window.
evidencePrompts: Measure offered work, completed work, completion windows, and the eligible completion ratio.
scenarioPrompts: Offer the stated rate and exercise expiry, propagation, or scheduled work against its deadline.
clauses.title: Throughput and timeliness

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Memory, processor, storage, and connection use remain bounded and proportionate to the unit of work, with no leak or unrelated-state scaling across an operation boundary.
evidencePrompts: Measure resource ceilings per request, retained record, subject, or time window and detect drift.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise representative and boundary workloads through steady state and recovery.
clauses.title: Resource efficiency

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Operating limits exist for bounded resources and behavior at and beyond each limit is an explicit rejection, shedding, or backpressure decision.
evidencePrompts: Show that admitted work meets its objective and excess work receives the defined response.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise each stated boundary and at least one beyond-boundary case.
clauses.title: Capacity

qualities.summary: Quality-significant operations respond within stated time, rate, resource, and capacity limits under named conditions.
qualities.title: Performance

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Repeated, concurrent, reordered, and retried inputs produce outcomes within an explicit accepted set, including any permitted nondeterminism.
evidencePrompts: Assert the complete accepted outcome set and zero invariant violations across controlled schedules.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise duplicates, reordered delivery, concurrency, and retries where the interface admits them.
clauses.title: Stability and predictability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The subject serves within a stated failure model that names tolerated faults, service-limiting faults, and restart posture.
evidencePrompts: Measure the good-event ratio over the stated window and record which failure modes the objective includes.
scenarioPrompts: Introduce each named failure mode while exercising consumer-visible eligible events.
clauses.title: Availability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: When a dependency fails or misbehaves, the subject exhibits a designed bounded response such as shedding, queuing, retry, disclosed staleness, or loud refusal.
evidencePrompts: Verify the degraded response, bounds, disclosure, and time to a terminal decision for every row.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise a dependency-fault matrix covering timeout, refusal, lag, malformed response, and recovery where relevant.
clauses.title: Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

clauses.affirmativeObligation: After interruption at any admitted point, the subject returns to a recognized correct state and completes, compensates, or reports in-flight work without silent partial effect.
evidencePrompts: Verify accepted postconditions plus stated recovery-time and recovery-point bounds.
scenarioPrompts: Interrupt each persisted transition point and restart under permitted duplicate delivery.
clauses.title: Recoverability

qualities.summary: The subject behaves predictably, remains available within a stated failure model, degrades deliberately, and recovers to a known-good state.
qualities.title: Reliability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The affected boundary and possible physical consequences are declared so informational harms and physical hazards route to their appropriate obligations.
evidencePrompts: Inspect deployment-boundary evidence and classify every credible harm path.
scenarioPrompts: Identify what the subject controls or gates and the consequence of an incorrect allow, deny, delay, or stale result.
clauses.title: Scope declaration

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Before a boundary can actuate or gate a physical-consequence process, its hazards, safe failure states, operating constraints, warnings, and verification obligations are defined.
evidencePrompts: Verify the safe state, response deadline, warning path, constraint, and exact acceptance evidence.
scenarioPrompts: For each material hazard, exercise the initiating stimulus in normal, boundary, and fault environments.
clauses.title: Activation obligation

qualities.summary: Hazards to people, property, and the environment are explicitly bounded, and physical-consequence integrations define safe failure behavior before use.
qualities.title: Safety

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Information is readable only by authorized principals and does not leak through responses, timing, caches, diagnostics, or auxiliary surfaces.
evidencePrompts: Verify zero unauthorized disclosure and preservation of the declared custody boundary.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise authorized and unauthorized actor classes across every relevant read and side channel.
clauses.title: Confidentiality

clauses.affirmativeObligation: State changes only through authorized, validated paths, with external input validated before reliance and tampering detectable where the trust model requires it.
evidencePrompts: Verify zero unauthorized effects and validation before any decision or mutation.
scenarioPrompts: Attempt authorized, unauthorized, malformed, replayed, and tampered mutations at each trust boundary.
clauses.title: Integrity

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Every consequential action is attributable to a specific principal with enough structured evidence to reconstruct who acted, what occurred, when, and under which authority.
evidencePrompts: Recover the principal, action, authority, ordering information, and protected evidence from retained records.
scenarioPrompts: Perform consequential actions and later reconstruct them without ambient memory.
clauses.title: Accountability and auditability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Identities are verified at the point of reliance, and dispute-relevant actions retain durable proof binding the actor to the act.
evidencePrompts: Verify the identity proof and durable binding between actor, authority, and action.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise identity claims at reliance points and later dispute representative consequential acts.
clauses.title: Authenticity and non-repudiation

clauses.affirmativeObligation: External input is distrusted by default, work before verification is bounded, abuse opportunities are rate-limited where needed, and exposed attack surface is deliberately minimal.
evidencePrompts: Measure work, amplification, concurrency, and rate ceilings before trust is established.
scenarioPrompts: Apply hostile, malformed, amplified, concurrent, and over-rate inputs at and beyond stated bounds.
clauses.title: Resistance

qualities.summary: Information and operations are protected so authorized identities alone may read or change them, consequential acts are attributable, and deliberate misuse is resisted.
qualities.title: Security

clauses.affirmativeObligation: A person can determine what the subject offers and whether it fits their need from its visible description and interaction surfaces.
evidencePrompts: Observe successful capability discovery using only the available description and self-description surfaces.
scenarioPrompts: Begin at the shipped entry point and locate a named capability without inspecting its implementation.
clauses.title: Discoverability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: The path from no prior knowledge to first success is short, documented, complete, and honest about prerequisites.
evidencePrompts: Record completion, missing knowledge, prerequisite accuracy, and recovery from any failed step.
scenarioPrompts: Have a competent newcomer complete a first-success journey from a clean environment.
clauses.title: Learnability

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Routine tasks require proportionate effort, use consistent vocabulary, and begin from defaults that do not surprise in a harmful direction.
evidencePrompts: Observe task outcome, required steps, consistency, and recovery burden.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise recurring tasks in clean and previously configured environments, including dangerous defaults.
clauses.title: Operability and defaults

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Irreversible effects are difficult to trigger accidentally, errors name corrective action, and partial failures state the resulting condition.
evidencePrompts: Verify prevention or explicit blast radius, resulting state, and actionable correction.
scenarioPrompts: Induce representative mistakes, irreversible requests, and partial failures.
clauses.title: Error prevention and recovery

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Responses explain current state and requirements with actionable detail, and descriptive surfaces match the behavior that is available.
evidencePrompts: Verify that each response identifies the condition, required action, and available state without implementation archaeology.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise success, refusal, and degraded states using only information available at the interaction boundary.
clauses.title: Self-descriptiveness and assistance

clauses.affirmativeObligation: Interaction surfaces remain meaningful without color or interactivity and provide machine-readable forms where text scraping would otherwise be required.
evidencePrompts: Verify equivalent meaning and task completion across the supported human-readable and machine-readable paths.
scenarioPrompts: Exercise relevant non-color, non-interactive, assistive, and constrained environments.
clauses.title: Accessibility

qualities.summary: People can discover, learn, operate, recover, and automate the available interaction surfaces in differing environments.
qualities.title: Usability
